title: Seatbelt position, sliding seat, and recall mentions
summary: Feedback in this topic covers seatbelt comfort and positioning concerns, a liked seat-sliding feature when unbuckling, and recall mentions that do not clearly express sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the seat sliding back when the seatbelt is unbuckled.

negative.summary: Negative feedback focuses on the seatbelt digging into the neck when trying to raise the seat for better visibility.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a seatbelt recall and belt positioning that scrapes near the column without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: The topic mixes a positive seat-sliding feature with seatbelt comfort, positioning, and recall references rather than one single issue.
The sample is very small, and two fragments are undetermined, which limits how specifically the feedback can be characterized.
